titre: TOEIC Grammar — 08 Les temps du passé
description: Present perfect, prétérit et past perfect, simples et en -ING.

questions.question: The town's first purpose-built central library …… by Kirk Kendall and dates back from 1952.
questions.explication: *Back from 1952* indique un passé révolu ; la bibliothèque subit l'action, donc voix passive : `was designed`.

questions.question: Given that Tyson & Brickell …… afternoon tea in London for more than 300 years, Dubai's new branch of the historic store has a lot to live up to.
questions.explication: *For more than 300 years* (durée très longue) + *has to live up to* (jusqu'au présent) : `has been serving` (present perfect en -ING).

questions.question: As Marlington …… as a trading center, the market spilled down the hill from the Parish Church.
questions.explication: *Spilled down* est un passé révolu et *as* indique la concomitance : prétérit `grew`.

questions.question: These organic multi-cereal buns …… by McCain since 1978.
questions.explication: `Since 1978` → present perfect ; les petits pains ne peuvent pas être acteurs : passif `have been produced`.

questions.question: If my team and I …… so busy with the Xen project, we would have loved to support your venture.
questions.explication: Le conditionnel passé (*would have loved*) implique un past perfect dans la subordonnée : `had not been`.

questions.question: These tasteful and colorful dishes which …… for Mr. and Mrs. Hayne's wedding will be served on golden plates.
questions.explication: *Will be served* indique que l'action n'est pas encore faite : present perfect passif `have been specially created`.

questions.question: Appleton is a huge canvas for hundreds of street artists, who little by little …… it their artistic showcase.
questions.explication: *Is* indique le contexte présent et *little by little* la progression : present perfect `have made`.

questions.question: With my job I can use the technical and creative knowledge and experience I …… in industry when I worked for Barnes Inc.
questions.explication: *Worked* place l'action dans un passé révolu, l'expérience acquise en même temps : prétérit `gained`.

questions.question: I heard Gaile & Softy Inc. …… the boundaries of innovation by producing ground-breaking games.
questions.explication: *Heard* indique que l'action est passée mais continue de se produire : prétérit en -ING `was pushing`.

questions.question: Our Thank You Awards …… since 2002 and this year we are pleased to congratulate Davis Dreedy for his commitment to our firm and huge achievement.
questions.explication: *Since 2002* avec un contexte présent : present perfect en -ING `have been running`.
